thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/25/2019: CLRO, WDC, INTC, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/25/2019: CLRO, WDC, INTC, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.97%
AAPL: +1.62%
IBM: -0.02%
CSCO: Flat
GOOG: +0.75%
Technology stocks were advancing pre-market Friday.
Early movers include:
(+) ClearOne ( CLRO ), which was surging 23% after saying the US Patent and Trademark Office has upheld its patents covering technologies in beamforming microphone arrays ( BMA ) in a patent dispute with Shure Inc.
(+) Western Digital ( WDC ) was up more than 10% as it booked fiscal 2019 Q2 non-GAAP income of $1.45 a share, missing the consensus on Capital IQ for $1.50 a share and beneath the year earlier $3.95 a share.
(-) Intel ( INTC ) was down over 6% after i t report ed fourth quarter sales that missed analysts' expectations late Thursday as it forecast turnover would lag the market's projections in the first quarter as well as in the full-year. Adjusted earnings per share rose to $1.28, from $1.08 a year earlier, beating the market consensus of $1.22.
